subject.title: [Feature]: /learn command — distill recent work into a reviewable skill draft

question: Should OpenClaw accept `/learn` as a built-in core chat command that wraps the existing Skill Workshop proposal flow, including reserving the `learn` command name?
rationale: The backend proposal flow already exists and the linked PR shows a plausible implementation, but the request adds new user-facing command surface across channels and has a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR after blockers
options.body: Accept the thin core command after the PR resolves review findings, generated docs metadata, real behavior proof, and the namespace compatibility concern.

options.title: Keep Skill Workshop explicit
options.body: Reject or narrow the command if maintainers want users to continue asking the agent or using the CLI/workshop flow without a new slash command.

options.title: Route outside core
options.body: Ask for a plugin or ClawHub affordance if the command is useful but not worth adding to core command surface.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR after blockers
recommendation.body: Accept the thin core command after the PR resolves review findings, generated docs metadata, real behavior proof, and the namespace compatibility concern.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the protected feature request, authored the linked implementation PR, and have the clearest recent history on this exact command/workshop direction.
